question: Which directions should be resorted to on Tuesday and on Wednesday?
premises: Tuesday and Wednesday are specified days.
Certain directions are to be chosen on these days.
The text prescribes resorting to those directions.
inference: On Tuesday one should go north, and on Wednesday one should resort to that direction as well.
uncertainties: The token sequence and repetition in this verse is syntactically compressed and ambiguous.
plain_english: On Tuesday one should likewise go north, and on Wednesday also one should resort to that direction.
